club_error.method: mean product of one club's residuals in two late-regular-season games against different opponents

production.method: tau = sqrt(2) x sigma_club: the error in the difference of two independent clubs' ratings, in points of final margin
production.note: Carved out of the served margin distribution: each game keeps exactly its served probability on average; tau only makes a series' games move together.

postseason_check.method: mean product of two games' residuals within one playoff series, from the same club's side
